description: This file defines the AppUserRepositoryWrapper class, which is a Spring service component that wraps interactions with AppUserRepository to fetch system user details, specifically the system user by name and handle exceptions if not found.

classes.name: AppUserRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service wrapper for AppUserRepository, providing methods to fetch system application user and handle exceptions when user is not found.

methods.name: fetchSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves the system user by name; throws UserNotFoundException if the user does not exist.
